title: Examples of the deployment (examples.yaml) v0.3.0
description: Per actor, under the id of its cell: default data for a trial setup, each a JSON file relative to this file. The frontend offers them to prefill a login, an application or the form of an act; the runtime does not record them and checks them like any other input. Only the structure of this index is described here: the JSON files are free data in the shape of the input they stand for.

logins.description: Logins, each a JSON object with the fields of a channel and optionally channel and role. The file name without extension is the label.

actions.description: Per act, by the name of its event: a JSON object {form: {...}}.

path.description: A JSON file, relative to the directory of this file.
